profile: spanning set: a set of vectors, drawn as arrows, that are particular points in a space. It is often called a basis; it is the set of vectors over which we aim to represent every other point in the space.

draft.profile: spanning set: a set of vectors, drawn as arrows, that serve as particular points in a space. This set is used as a basis for representation: every other point in the space is intended to be represented in terms of these vectors. A spanning set is often called a basis.
